top_signals.title: China's EV makers shift gears to focus on humanoids as car market slows
top_signals.summary: As Chinese electric car sales slow and share prices tumble, several of the automakers are ramping up humanoid robotics development.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Malone Lam pleads guilty in $245M crypto theft conspiracy
top_signals.summary: US prosecutors said Lam organized an international network that targeted cryptocurrency holders through social engineering and home break-ins.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: JPMorgan, Jane Street Probes Show India Scrutinizing Traders
top_signals.summary: India is ramping up scrutiny of Wall Street traders with the nation’s securities regulator turning more aggressive in targeting even prominent foreign players like JPMorgan Chase & Co. in its $5 trillion stock market.
